PluginCheck.CodeAnalysis.DiscouragedFunc.reason: Runs on init to also support private/legacy installations and bundled translations, not only WordPress.org language packs.

WordPress.DB.DirectDatabaseQuery.DirectQ.reason: The plugin owns relational tables, atomic rate counters and transaction locks that have no equivalent high-level WordPress API.

WordPress.DB.DirectDatabaseQuery.NoCachi.reason: Authorization, locks and encrypted field hydration use fresh reads; persistent caching of decrypted tenant data is intentionally avoided.

WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Rec.reason: Read-only, sanitized GET filters/navigation and preflight routing; write handlers separately verify their operation-specific nonce.
